title: New request
intro: You ask a customer for a secret value, for example credentials. The customer needs no login. Their reply is encrypted in their browser, and only you can open it.
questionHint: The customer sees this, for example “Credentials for the staging server”. Please do not put anything secret here.
passphraseHint: Protects your private key. Without it the reply is lost for good, there is no recovery. At least {min} characters, ideally a long sentence.
linkHint: Send this link to your customer. It is shown only now. The part after the # makes sure the customer gets the right key; the server never sees it.

errors.question: Please enter a question (at most 200 characters).
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.quota: You have reached the limit of running requests (200). Delete old requests or wait until they expire.
